Production AI systems often fail due to missing retries, hidden state, and weak observability.

A practical orchestration layer should record step status, attempt counts, and error categories.

Agent handoffs reduce prompt overload by transferring summarized context between specialized workers.

Structured outputs with citations improve auditability and downstream integration quality.

# Human-In-The-Loop Workflow Controls

Approval checkpoints prevent unsafe automation from proceeding without review.

A review gate should include reason, summary, candidate data, reviewer decision, reviewer note, and timestamp.

When approvals are deferred, workflow state should persist so runs can resume without redoing successful steps.

Trace files and state snapshots make debugging and governance easier for engineering teams.

Reliable automation depends on traceable execution events, not only message history.

Human approval gates are useful when output can trigger expensive or risky operations.
